title: Public Health Emergencies | Grants | CDC
content: Public Health Emergencies Sept. 15, 2025 At a glance The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) applicants and recipients can use the links below for general guidance about administrative relief during public health emergencies, and grants-related information specific to public health emergency responses. General guidance The Department of Health and Human Services may authorize the temporary reassignment of personnel during a declared federal public health emergency. For more information, click on the link below. Temporary Reassignment of Personnel An overview of how to request temporary reassignment of personnel during a health emergency. Public health responses These links provide grants-related information specific to public health emergency responses. Flexibilities Guidance for Applicants and Recipients of Federal Financial Assistance Directly Impacted by Hurricanes Helene and Milton An overview of the flexibilities guidance for federal financial assistance for some 2024 hurricanes Mpox A collection of resources and information on the federal response to mpox. Flexibilities Guidance for Applicants and Recipients of Federal Financial Assistance Affected by the 2022 Hurricanes and Alaska Storms An overview of the flexibilities guidance for federal financial assistance for some 2022 hurricanes. Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) A collection of resources, information, and policies for the COVID-19 virus. Flexibilities Guidance for Applicants and Recipients of Federal Financial Assistance Directly Impacted by the California Wildfires An overview of the flexibilities guidance for funding recipients affected by California wildfires..
